intro.title: What is heat recovery ventilation?
intro.paragraph1: MVHR is a modern ventilation system that provides a constant air exchange in your building without opening windows. Stale air is removed, and fresh, pre-filtered and pre-heated air is supplied in its place.
intro.paragraph2: The result: always fresh air at home, with no heat loss and no influence from outside conditions.

items.title: Real savings and lower bills
items.description: MVHR can recover up to 80–90% of the heat from the air extracted from your home. That means less energy lost and real savings on heating, especially in new, well-insulated buildings. The investment pays back through lower bills and a more efficient heating system.

items.title: Comfort and healthy air all year
items.description: With MVHR you no longer need to open windows to ventilate. The system runs continuously, delivering fresh, filtered air without drafts, noise or outdoor pollution.

items.title: A proper installation = trouble-free for years
items.description: MVHR works well only when it's well designed and well installed. That's why we focus on:
bullets: an individual design matched to the building

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything worth knowing about heat recovery ventilation before you decide to install

items.question: How much does MVHR installation cost in a single-family home?
items.answer: The cost depends on the floor area, room layout and the chosen unit. Installation starts from a few thousand euros' worth of work, and we give a final price after a free on-site visit. Part of the investment can be covered by available subsidies.

items.question: Is heat recovery ventilation worth it?
items.answer: Yes. MVHR recovers up to 90% of the heat from extracted air, which genuinely lowers heating bills. The investment pays back through lower energy costs, and you get fresh, filtered air all year round.

items.question: How does heat recovery ventilation work?
items.answer: MVHR is mechanical ventilation with heat recovery. The system continuously removes stale air and supplies fresh air that has been filtered and pre-heated using the warmth of the extracted air, with no need to open windows.

items.question: Can MVHR be installed in an existing house?
items.answer: Yes. In renovated or finished buildings we use surface-mounted solutions and ducts routed within boxing. During the on-site visit we choose the option that interferes least with your finishes.

items.question: Can I get funding for MVHR?
items.answer: Yes. MVHR can be financed through programmes such as Czyste Powietrze, Moje Ciepło or the OZE loan in Małopolska. We help you pick the right programme and handle the paperwork.

items.question: How often does MVHR need servicing?
items.answer: Filters should be replaced every 3 to 6 months, and we recommend a full inspection with cleaning and disinfection once a year. Regular servicing keeps the system efficient and the air clean.

items.question: How long does MVHR installation take?
items.answer: In a typical single-family home the installation usually takes 2 to 4 working days, depending on the floor area and how complex the routing is. We confirm the exact schedule after the design stage.
